text: MARA: You sold our home without telling me?
ACTION: Mara holds a foreclosure letter. Her brother Leo blocks the doorway.
LEO: I borrowed money for Dad's operation. I thought I could pay it back.
MARA: The hospital said someone already paid. Who took your money?
ACTION: Leo looks at the signature on the letter. His hand begins to shake.
LEO: Wait. Why does this have your husband's signature?
ACTION: A key turns in the lock. Mara's husband opens the door.
HUSBAND: I can explain. I bought the debt to save the house.
MARA: Then why did you order us to leave?
ACTION: He reaches for the letter, but a second envelope falls from his coat.
STRANGER: Stop the wedding. That man is already married.
ACTION: The bride Iris lowers her bouquet. Guests turn to the woman at the chapel doors.
IRIS: Daniel, who is she?
DANIEL: My wife died three years ago. I buried her myself.
ACTION: The stranger lifts a photograph of herself and Daniel.
STRANGER: Then tell me whose body you buried?
ACTION: Daniel steps back, stunned, as the stranger removes her glove.
DANIEL: You're her twin sister. You promised never to return.
ACTION: Two people walk through a garden.
ELI: The flowers look nice this year.
JUNE: Yes. I watered them yesterday.
